project_design.title: GPX route editor with map-style track editing
project_design.prompt: Build a website that loads a GPX file by drag and drop or file picker. The main view should be an intuitive interactive map-style track editor taking most of the visible screen, with only a compact tools palette. It should support zooming, panning/moving, adding points at the end, inserting points in the middle, removing waypoints, and saving/exporting the edited GPX. Level 2: display length in kilometers and miles. Level 3: if real map surface data is not available without a key, use a deterministic local fallback that colors route segments by walking, road-bike, and mountain-bike suitability and summarizes risky/busy segment length. Validation must not require an external map API key. The implementation agent must create the project itself; do not rely on prewritten harness data. Group the implementation plan into at most 5 independently verifiable steps. Keep each implementation attempt small: prefer one vertical slice or no more than 3 files per model response.
